question.text: What activities are the paper-cutting artist and the physical education teacher mentioned by Lin Shu in the conversation responsible for?

questions.original_answer: Paper Cutting Instruction, Traditional Game Guidance

supporting_evidence.content: Lin Shu: Our community has the space to plan these specialized areas. I'll take care of coordinating logistics and volunteers, Mingyuan, you focus more on activity design and educational value. By the way, the parent-child activity idea bank you shared earlier, such as nature treasure hunts and family theater nights, can also be integrated.

Zhou Mingyuan: For children, diverse activities can enhance engagement. We could try this: set up a 'Cultural Experience Corner,' invite paper-cutting artists to teach, and have retired physical education teachers guide traditional games. Follow-up feedback is crucial—collect opinions after the activities.
